scope: One local investigation of a real borrower and a proposed new discretionary advance, followed by loan cash-flow scenario comparison and independent review. Analysis candidates are not claims of actual Slope offers or customers.

default_mission.cutoff_precision: Conservative end of the disclosed filing date; not an asserted intraday SEC acceptance timestamp or actual loan-decision time.
default_mission.updated_cash_precision: Approximately USD 2 million, as disclosed by management; not an exact current bank balance or a reconciliation of every post-June cash movement.
default_mission.relationship_claim: No claim that Synergy is or was a Slope customer, applied to Slope, received this offer, or qualified for a particular partner program.
default_mission.product_selection: Compare explicitly modeled fixed-installment working-capital offers compatible with Slope's product family. Do not describe current partner marketing terms as an offer available to Synergy in August 2024. Store the actual existing merchant loan under its own sales-linked contract logic.
default_mission.existing_merchant_loan_role: The May 1 WebBank loan, described by the issuer as Shopify Capital, is an existing obligation and a contract-engine test: USD 370000 advanced, USD 418100 total contractual repayment, remittance from 25 percent of defined Shopify Account Credits. Section 4.1.1 requires a 30 percent Minimum Payment in months 1-6 and an additional 30 percent Minimum Payment in months 7-12, with total repayment at least 60 percent by month 12 and full payment by the end of month 18. Section 4.2(b) computes each period top-up from Daily Payments in that six-month period; do not replace the second-period rule with a cumulative 60 percent test that credits first-period excess. All dates run from the effective funding date, not automatically the agreement date. This sales-linked existing loan is not the proposed Slope-style fixed-installment loan.

transfer_mission.financing_basis: Analysis candidate for new inventory funding alongside the documented receivables facility; no actual Slope relationship asserted.

runtime.lock_policy: Create and retain uv.lock after a local authentication and custom-tool smoke test; do not claim package compatibility merely from this design file.

claude_model_ids.scope: The official provider lists these IDs. This does not establish their availability in the user's authenticated subscription runtime, and an ID is not proof of immutable underlying weights.

local_smoke_test_gate.reason: This deliverable is a design contract. No subscription session, model request or SDK installation was performed.
must_pass_before_case_execution: Install the exact requested SDK versions and freeze resolved dependencies; record SDK and bundled CLI versions.
Verify native subscription authentication with no unintended API-provider overrides and confirm the requested main model is available.
Invoke a harmless scoped MCP tool through ClaudeSDKClient and receive valid schema-constrained output; verify built-in and ambient tools are unavailable.
Make one focused Jev request using the pinned model and preserve its returned model, typed answer and raw response.
Confirm the chosen reviewer can read the complete eligible evidence bundle and cannot read outcome or answer files.
local_smoke_test_gate.failure_behavior: Stop before case execution with FAILED_CONFIGURATION. Select any runtime/model change explicitly and record a revised configuration; never silently switch to metered inference.

main_agent.model_substitution_policy: If the specified model is unavailable, stop for explicit local configuration selection. Record the actual model used; do not silently substitute a different model or metered provider.

runtime_bindings_required.mcp_servers: Inject exactly one scoped credit MCP server into ClaudeAgentOptions.mcp_servers. No ambient MCP servers.
runtime_bindings_required.cwd: Create an empty per-run working directory containing no acquired corpus, prior output, outcome evidence or evaluation answers.
runtime_bindings_required.system_prompt: Combine the role instruction and explicit invariants below into a custom system prompt. Do not load the coding-agent default prompt.
runtime_bindings_required.output_format: Inject a concrete Pydantic-generated JSON Schema for the decision packet using the SDK's json_schema output format; no unresolved schema path is passed as a schema.

prohibited_auth_paths: custom OAuth token extraction or proxy
main_agent.auth_preflight: Confirm official subscription sign-in and detect provider/key overrides without printing values. Refuse unintended metered inference. Include the installed runtime version and chosen model in the run record.

jev.authentication: TYPESAFE_API_KEY available only to the host-side tool handler
jev.subscription_coverage: Separate service; Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions do not include Jev usage.
jev.version_policy: Verify the actual returned model ID equals the pinned version and retain the raw response. Reject unexpected version changes for evaluation comparability.
jev.retry_policy: SDK RetryPolicy set explicitly; the host reserves 1 + max_retries physical attempts per request against the attempt ceiling. No second retry wrapper.
jev.spend_cap_policy: Host reserves a conservative estimated input-token charge before dispatch and reconciles actual usage. This caps Jev service spend only, not Claude/Codex subscription usage.

candidate_screen.trigger: host, on every search_evidence result; one request per query-passage pair

claim_interpretation.trigger: agent via judge; and host, for every finding that supports a proposed effect (status question chosen by the effect's mechanism)
claim_interpretation.selection: entity_scope and claim_posture always; the status question matching the claim's declared subject

statement_relation.trigger: agent via judge; host on each accepted finding against the most recent accepted finding under the same dependency; host for baseline overlap

snapshot_sweep.trigger: host, once per snapshot before investigation; cached; own budget

statement_support.trigger: host, on every propose_effect consequence and on submit_packet conclusion

inventory_coverage.trigger: host, per section, on every inventory item the agent marks covered, duplicate or not decision-relevant

jev.state_policy: The host builds each state from immutable run objects (dependency text, evidence section or table text with its heading path, agent-authored claim or finding). The agent never supplies raw Jev state or question IDs.
jev.screen_policy: Screening labels and orders candidates as direct evidence, conflict or context-only using code-owned thresholds; it never removes a candidate from the agent's view.

reviewer.model_policy: Select an available reasoning model through the installed Codex subscription configuration; freeze that model choice for an evaluation set and record the actual identifier. No fabricated model pin.
reviewer.structured_output: JSONL event log plus --output-schema with a concrete reviewer-report schema
reviewer.access: Candidate packet plus the complete admissible source interface, not just quotations chosen by the main agent.
reviewer.isolation: Use only scoped tools, or an OS-isolated directory containing the eligible review bundle. A read-only filesystem sandbox alone is not a proof of read isolation.
reviewer.initial_integration_alternative: A fresh separately scoped Claude subscription session with model claude-sonnet-5 may review the first milestone. Configure this choice explicitly before the run; it is not a silent failure fallback.

role_instruction: Investigate an external event only to the extent needed to evaluate the financing request. Record the decision-relevant unknowns, search and read admissible evidence, and propose atomic findings that quote the evidence exactly. Jev screens retrieved evidence and checks narrow semantic claims; you reconcile its judgments with the evidence and may disagree with a failed check by replying to it with a stated reason, or escalate it for the reviewer where the host requires escalation. Translate accepted findings into economic effect proposals and use the sensitivity tool to see which unknowns change the result. Code computes dates, money, schedules and cash flows. Finish with the pivotal unresolved inputs and the supported effects, or the exact missing fact that prevents a conclusion. Do not claim to send an offer, change an account, or know Slope's private policy.
invariants: Start with the same baseline profile, existing obligations, decision date and candidate financing request for the before/after comparison.
Keep borrower cash flows, contractual loan payments, scenario collections and funding-facility cash flows distinct.
Use only evidence admitted by the host's snapshot rules. Do not use remembered future outcomes.
All amounts, dates and parameter values have reported, derived or operator-assumption basis; unknown remains unknown.
Use source-supported ranges or named scenario parameters where exact values are unavailable. Never silently interpolate financial statements into daily historical facts.
Do not turn Jev confidence or lawsuit severity into default probabilities or dollar adjustments.
Track legal-entity, asset, product, channel and period scope for every adjustment.
Reconcile every patch with baseline entries to prevent double counting; preserve associated avoided costs, recoveries and delayed receipts.
Do not automatically rewrite existing contractual payments, assume new creditor seniority, or freeze committed credit.
Do not label loan principal collections or all interest as Slope corporate revenue; use the selected stakeholder accounting scope.
Do not assume lower principal is always safer; financed inventory and resulting receipts must respond to the action chosen.
A missing incidental fact need not block the decision. A pivotal missing fact requires its exact question and the action consequences of alternative answers.
Runtime or quota failure means incomplete investigation, not an adverse borrower recommendation.

tools.scope_enforcement: The host binds scope at run creation. Tools do not accept arbitrary filesystem paths, database names, network endpoints, case IDs or later cutoffs from the model.

read_tools.get_mission: Construct a fresh mission object using mission_projection.allowed_case_fields and allowed_run_input_fields only. Never return the raw mission/configuration object. Return the financing question, use of proceeds, allowed policy/product references and cutoff without evaluator expectations or future hints.
read_tools.read_baseline_profile: Read source-backed opening balances, receipts, operating expenses, existing financing and explicit assumptions by field or stream ID.
read_tools.read_loan_terms: Return existing contractual schedules and permitted analysis-candidate schedules, with exact pricing/convention basis.
read_tools.search_evidence: Search eligible records for one recorded decision dependency; return dated snippets and IDs. In the agent-plus-Jev arm each candidate carries its candidate_screen labels; no candidate is withheld.
read_tools.read_evidence: Return a selected section or table with heading path, definitions, units, surrounding context and source metadata.

analysis_tools.record_dependency: Record one decision-relevant unknown premise, the financial quantity or action it could change, and what evidence could resolve it.
analysis_tools.judge: Request a judgment profile (claim_interpretation or statement_relation) by object IDs plus one agent-stated claim; the host builds minimal state and returns typed semantic observations.
analysis_tools.propose_finding: Propose one atomic finding with exact source spans (section/table ID, character offsets, verbatim quote). The host verifies spans verbatim and runs finding_check; returns observations for the agent to resolve.
analysis_tools.resolve_finding: Accept or reject a proposed finding, recording how each semantic observation was used or why it was overridden.
analysis_tools.propose_effect: Propose an economic effect from accepted findings: mechanism, target stream, parameter requirements, baseline treatment and linked effects. Validated by the finance engine; never activated by Jev output.
analysis_tools.run_sensitivity: Run deterministic thresholds or ledger sensitivities over explicit parameter bounds and return which values change the result.
analysis_tools.request_missing_fact: Record the exact requested fact/document and the action consequences. This tool sends no communication.
analysis_tools.submit_packet: Lock the investigation graph, source hashes, findings, effects and calculation versions for review. No lending action.
analysis_tools.read_inventory: List the host sweep inventory: specific matters flagged in the admissible evidence, with their accounting status.
analysis_tools.account_for_items: Account for inventory items: covered by named accepted findings, a duplicate of a covered item, or not decision-relevant with a reason; each claim is checked per section. A failed check is closed with a new finding or a verified duplicate, or escalated with the failed observation ID and what is missing (the item is disputed and stays open for the reviewer). The packet cannot be submitted while items are open.
analysis_tools.escalate_effect: Escalate an effect the category guard rejected: it becomes disputed, creates no cash stream and is left for the reviewer; a disputed cash-moving effect makes the run INCOMPLETE_REVIEW.
analysis_tools.resolve_reconciliation: Resolve an open reconciliation task with a note on how the statements relate.

disallowed_capabilities: unscoped shell or code execution by the agent
unrestricted browser or network search during historical runs
reading outcome stores, old reports, goldens or another run's mutable facts
posting messages, email or borrower requests
writing to Slope, bank, marketplace or servicing systems
making offers, moving funds, changing limits or editing existing contracts
changing model/provider/auth configuration during the run

budgets.no_progress_definition: An action produces no new eligible evidence, no corrected finding, no resolved/narrowed gap, no new valid patch and no changed sensitivity result. Repeating the same query alone is not progress.
budgets.budget_policy: Ceilings, not targets. Record actual elapsed time, token usage, requests and spend. Finish early when further accessible evidence cannot change the action across the stated sensitivity range.
budgets.turn_counting: A turn is one distinct model response (message_id), counted by the host and enforced by interrupting the session. The SDK's num_turns counts differently and is recorded only for reference.

completion_and_decisions.failure_recommendation_policy: Keep any prior provisional recommendation in the trace, but do not publish it as a completed result. Set final lending recommendation UNDETERMINED unless an independently completed supported decision packet exists. Execution failure itself is never a reason for DECLINE_REQUEST.
completion_and_decisions.complete_with_pivotal_gap: A reviewed packet may finish with UNDETERMINED and a precise borrower question plus action map. It must not claim that the financing decision has been resolved.
completion_and_decisions.conditional_offer_requirement: Specify the exact condition, acceptable resolving evidence, deadline if supported, and the amount/term/schedule offered when the condition is satisfied. Generic monitoring is not a condition.
completion_and_decisions.submission_requirement: Every final action must reference the source-supported mechanisms, explicit assumptions, considered offers and financial results that justify it.

state_and_replay.run_isolation: Facts, gaps, patches, calculations and outputs are scoped by run_id; snapshot_id alone is insufficient because repeated evaluations must not share mutable state.
state_and_replay.final_packet: Immutable graph of source versions, accepted findings, effects, assumption set, scenarios, calculation versions, chosen action and review report.
state_and_replay.date_update: Create a fresh mission/snapshot. Reuse eligible immutable observations while retaining original measurement dates; recompute time-dependent applicability and resulting cash flows.
state_and_replay.agent_only_policy: Use the same primary model, admissible evidence, research tools, financial tools, review treatment and comparable total budgets. Remove mcp__credit__judge, the screening fields on search results, the automatic finding check and the Jev registry from model context, and replace the role instruction with the agent-only override. This is an explicitly selected evaluation arm, never a service-failure fallback.

cache.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON; preserve numeric units and string values

exclusions: as_of only if the question genuinely does not depend on it
immutable_interpretation.eligibility_on_every_reuse: Verify all source versions are admitted in the current snapshot and the exact relevant semantic state matches. Return original creation time and a cache-hit marker.
immutable_interpretation.restriction: Interpretations whose instructions depend on current applicability, date or active document set belong in the dated cache, not this cache.

dated_application.restriction: Never reuse across a changed key. New time alone can change applicability, debt service and funding needs even without a new document.

cache.failed_call_policy: Never substitute a stale or ineligible cache result because a live request failed. An already eligible exact cache hit remains a normal logged operation.

validation_before_live_use: Enforce the selected case's stored source IDs and conservative date cutoffs; preserve date-only precision where no intraday acceptance timestamp is asserted.
Confirm package installation, official subscription auth, custom MCP access and JSON-schema output in the user's local runtime.
Validate every Choice criteria boundary against source-labeled examples, including unknown and combined-claim cases.
Exercise cross-run isolation, future-document exclusion and dated-cache invalidation.
Validate scenario conservation, baseline double counting and separation of contractual schedule from collection paths.
Make one actual Jev request and retain its raw versioned result before claiming a live Jev integration.
Do not publish the existing historical case's known outcome as proof that the modeled counterfactual offer was optimal.
Build the get_mission response from the explicit whitelist and assert that evaluator-only fields, future identities and expected findings cannot appear in initial agent context.
Verify case_eval_private.json is absent from both investigator and blind-reviewer filesystems and source interfaces.
For the actual merchant contract, test the second six-month Minimum Payment independently: excess first-period collections do not replace the second-period requirement under Section 4.2(b).
Verify the agent-only comparison arm removes both the Jev tool and registry-specific prompt requirements while preserving the research and financial tool set.

case_source_references.date_note: The agreement was publicly filed June 28 and is eligible on August 13. Its May 1 agreement date is not automatically the loan's effective funding date.

mission_projection.enforcement: get_mission constructs a fresh object from the explicit whitelist below. It must not serialize the mission dictionary or the full agent configuration wholesale. Extra keys are denied by default.
mission_projection.run_input_policy: Read these fields only from the locked operator request and ordinary baseline. Missing values remain typed unknown. An event seed may identify the borrower and disputed matter, but contains no expected conclusion, future identity, answer-bearing document order or extracted answer key. If mission_id is present in both case template and locked run inputs, they must match; a runtime override cannot switch cases.
mission_projection.financial_input_policy: The agent obtains sourced financial observations and documented existing-loan terms through read_baseline_profile and read_loan_terms. These tools may return ordinary baseline facts with source references; they do not return evaluator conclusions or the expected event adjustments.
mission_projection.blind_reviewer_policy: The reviewer sees the candidate packet and the same complete admissible evidence interface, but not this private evaluator file, answer keys, future outcomes, experimental arm labels or a predetermined preferred offer.

agent_only.role_instruction: Investigate an external event only to the extent needed to evaluate the financing request. Record the decision-relevant unknowns, search and read admissible evidence, make focused evidence judgments yourself, reconcile contradictions, and propose atomic findings that quote the evidence exactly. Translate accepted findings into economic effect proposals and use the sensitivity tool to see which unknowns change the result. Code computes dates, money, schedules and cash flows. Finish with the pivotal unresolved inputs and the supported effects, or the exact missing fact that prevents a conclusion. Do not claim to send an offer, change an account, or know Slope private policy.
agent_only.evaluation_metadata_visibility: Host scorer only; do not reveal arm labels or expected findings to the blind reviewer.
remove_host_semantic_checks: statement_support on effect consequences and the conclusion
